the material can reversibly react with 1.5 Li per formula unit.

it is possible to combine insertion and conversion reactions in a single composite material, which is a new approach to the development of higher capacity electrode materials.
the use of a mixed-anion host material allows for partitioning of the electrochemical reaction into insertion and conversion components.
